text: DOT × DeepSeek Harness MCP 是一个连接 DOT 与现有 DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 插件。它通过 Harness 公共插件 API 接入主聊天，可提交、排队、跟踪和取消任务，也能查找原生会话历史、搜索项目文件并读取指定文本。适合希望在 DOT 中复用已有 Harness、项目和会话的开发者；需要已有 Harness、DOT MCP 与 Tunnel 权限，并自行配置连接。

DOT × DeepSeek Harness MCP connects DOT to an existing Harness through MCP. It submits and tracks tasks, searches session history and project files, and reads selected text. Use it to work with existing Harness sessions from DOT; an existing Harness and configured DOT MCP/Tunnel access are required.

I want to delegate work from a DOT chat to my existing DeepSeek Harness.

I need to track a delegated run and recover its result after a disconnect.
Harness 任务派发：从 MCP 调用中指定工作区、任务和模型选项，提交到已有 Harness 会话并返回稳定会话链接。
原生会话历史搜索：按关键词查找已注册工作区的用户任务或助手结果，并返回命中消息的原文片段和位置。
项目文本搜索：在授权的项目目录中查找字面关键词，返回匹配路径、行号、文本摘录和文件摘要值。
会话与队列管理：查看原生会话和待处理队列，可移除队列项或把待处理项目引导到当前轮次。
任务跟踪与恢复：查询运行状态、等待任务结束，并核对原始操作记录，便于在中断后继续跟进。
DOT × DeepSeek Harness MCP 需要连接已有的 DeepSeek Harness Host；该集成不会另行启动 Harness 主机。

让 **DOT 主聊天直接操控已有的 DeepSeek Harness**：派任务、查进度、找历史、搜文件，并核对真实结果。复用现有项目、模型与会话，不另起 Harness Host，也不创建 Work/Codex 聊天。

harness-relay-mcp README · 可以用它做什么：| 你想做的事 | 它提供的能力 |
|---|---|
| 把任务交给 Harness | 提交任务、查看进度、续接会话、排队、引导和取消，保留原始任务与操作编号 |
| 找回以前做过的工作 | 按项目、会话、状态筛选任务；关键词检索原始历史，展开命中消息及前文 |
| 在项目中找到文件和代码 | 浏览目录、搜索文件内容，返回真实路径、匹配行和片段，再按行或末尾读取 |
| 核对结果与处理断线 | 用文件 SHA-256 校验内容；查询原请求和原生历史，避免不确定时重复派发 |

可以直接在 DOT 中描述目标，例如：

> “找一下这个项目之前做过的分页修复，把原来的结果给我。”
>
> “搜索项目里包含这个关键词的文件，告诉我文件名和具体行号。”
>
> “把这项修改交给 Harness，完成后读回结果并核对文件。”

harness-relay-mcp README · 它如何连接：```text
DOT 主聊天 → OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel → 本地 stdio proxy
          → 已有 Harness Host 内的 Relay 插件 → 原生项目、会话与任务
```

基于固定版本的 [Harness Relay MCP](https://github.com/tonytanglab/deepseek-harness-relay-mcp)，通过 Harness 公共插件 API 接入，不修改上游 Harness。固定来源及版本见 [UPSTREAM.json](UPSTREAM.json)。

使用前需要已有 Harness，以及账号、工作空间与 Platform 组织允许的 DOT / 自定义 MCP / Tunnel 权限。开源代码本身不授予这些产品权限。请参考[官方连接说明](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/secure-mcp-tunnels#connect-from-chatgpt)。

harness-relay-mcp README · 从源码开始：需要 Node.js **>=22.19**；CI 使用 pnpm **12.11.2**：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/xuanmingguo/dot-deepseek-harness-mcp.git
cd dot-deepseek-harness-mcp
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run prepack

`prepack` 包含类型检查、构建与包内容校验。最后生成 `harness-relay-mcp-0.2.18-dsh021a2.14.tgz`，按[安装与运维指南](docs/OPERATIONS.md)接入**已有** Harness profile，再配置自己的 Tunnel。

保留上游 npm 包名是为了兼容。**本 fork 尚未发布到 npm**；直接安装 registry 包或运行 `npx harness-relay-mcp` 不会选中这里的修改。

harness-relay-mcp README · 权限与隐私：`start_run` 缺省为只读。示例保持 `DSH_RELAY_TRUSTED_OPERATOR=false`；文件范围属于任务指令与准入校验，不是 OS 逐路径隔离。需要写入或部署时，按实际授权明确指定范围与权限，详见[权限约定](docs/TOOLS.md#权限选择与默认值)和[部署契约](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md)。

项目不提供模型凭据或订阅。Token、Tunnel 配置、原聊天历史、任务 journal、个人路径、备份和原始回执留在私有环境。发生超时或断线，先查原 `runId` / `operationId`，不要换键重派。

harness-relay-mcp README · 许可与贡献：采用 **MIT**；保留上游 [LICENSE](LICENSE) 与固定来源，维护归属见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)。这是独立维护的集成，不代表 OpenAI 或 DeepSeek 官方支持。

欢迎提供可复现的问题与改进，提交前请移除个人信息。见 [贡献说明](CONTRIBUTING.md)与[安全报告](SECURITY.md)。图示提供 PNG 与可编辑 SVG，均使用通用展示内容。

harness-relay-mcp README · DOT DeepSeek Harness MCP：No Work/Codex chat or second Harness runtime is required. DOT/custom MCP access and Tunnel availability depend on your account, workspace permissions and Platform organization; this repository does not grant that access. The Tunnel setup is for a private custom MCP connection, not a public plugin marketplace submission. See the [official connection guide](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/secure-mcp-tunnels#connect-from-chatgpt).
harness-relay-mcp README · What it provides：Version `0.2.18-dsh021a2.14` exposes 48 tools when connected to a compatible Host:

harness-relay-mcp README · What it provides：- Native task submission, progress, replies, queue controls and cancellation, with persistent run/operation IDs and idempotency.
- Compact run discovery, paged original history, keyword history search and original-message/context expansion.
- [Project file discovery](docs/PROJECT_FILES.md), [UTF-8 line/tail reads](docs/PROJECT_TEXT.md) and [literal content search](docs/PROJECT_SEARCH.md), with bounded results and SHA-256 checks.
- Native interactions, permission reconciliation, and explicitly scoped [deployment planning and evidence reads](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md).

harness-relay-mcp README · What it provides：The [tool catalog](docs/tool-catalog.json) describes the unconfigured defaults. Live `tools/list` and `get_operational_capabilities` describe the running configuration. A disconnected proxy may expose only `doctor`.

harness-relay-mcp README · A real search-to-read example：The diagram arranges a fresh original-DOT read-only result from a generic demo file; it is not a raw chat screenshot. Search found `notes/task-notes.md` at line 3, and `read_project_text` verified that line using the returned SHA-256. See the [sanitized result excerpt](docs/assets/demo-result.json). Paths are relative to the search directory. The file contains four lines; this read returned only the matching line, with continuation available.

harness-relay-mcp README · Build from source：Use Node.js **22.19 or later** and pnpm **12.11.2** (the CI version). From your clone:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/xuanmingguo/dot-deepseek-harness-mcp.git
cd dot-deepseek-harness-mcp
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run prepack

harness-relay-mcp README · Build from source：`prepack` performs type checks, builds the bundled runtime and validates the package. `npm pack --ignore-scripts` packages those already checked files into `harness-relay-mcp-0.2.18-dsh021a2.14.tgz`. The upstream npm package name is retained for compatibility; **this fork is not published to npm**. A registry install or `npx harness-relay-mcp` does not select this fork.

harness-relay-mcp README · Build from source：Install that local tarball into your existing Harness profile, configure the attached plugin and stdio proxy, then connect your private Tunnel: follow [OPERATIONS.md](docs/OPERATIONS.md). The guide includes the native CLI command, examples, account requirements and a small DOT acceptance path.

harness-relay-mcp README · Permissions and recovery：`start_run` defaults to `read-only` with `confirmedDangerousPermission=false`. A configured trusted operator can change omitted fields to full access; explicit call values take precedence. The examples keep that setting false. Workspace/task scopes are instructions and admission checks, not OS process isolation or multi-tenant access control. See the [permission contract](docs/TOOLS.md#权限选择与默认值).

harness-relay-mcp README · Permissions and recovery：Select provider/model/reasoning from the **actual existing Host capabilities**. Model credentials and defaults belong to the operator; no provider subscription or model access is bundled here.

harness-relay-mcp README · Permissions and recovery：Keep the original `runId`, `operationId`, `sessionId` and stable `idempotencyKey`. After a timeout or disconnect, query/reconcile that operation before deciding what to do next. A dispatch receipt, queued reply or HTTP 200 does not prove task completion. Cancellation must be verified from the final native state.

harness-relay-mcp README · Permissions and recovery：Keep tokens, Tunnel configuration, original chat history, task journals, backups and receipts outside Git. Report problems with a minimal sanitized reproduction; see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

harness-relay-mcp README · License and attribution：MIT; the upstream [LICENSE](LICENSE) is preserved unchanged. [NOTICE](NOTICE) and [UPSTREAM.json](UPSTREAM.json) identify the pinned upstream source and separate local maintenance. This is an independent integration, with no claim of official OpenAI or DeepSeek support.
